operations.name: Fermin Ocampo-Tellez

expected.name: Fermin Ocampo-Tellez
expected.description:
Fermin Ocampo-Tellez, of Aurora, Illinois, reported as twenty-seven at his arrest, was one of three men federally charged with conspiracy to commit bank theft after the night of May 31, 2020, when — amid the George Floyd uprising protests in downtown Aurora — a group tried to remove an ATM from its enclosure at a First Midwest Bank drive-through. The complaint says Ocampo-Tellez repeatedly struck the machine with a baseball bat in an unsuccessful attempt to move it; no money was taken, and the bank put the damage at thirty thousand dollars. He was arrested on July 1, 2020 with Diego Vargas and Michael Gomez and made an initial appearance in federal court in Chicago.

His disposition is unresolved in the accessible record. The docket ran long before Judge Matthew F. Kennelly, and a later entry sought a writ of habeas corpus ad prosequendum to produce him — indicating he was then in custody somewhere else — but no sentencing record, custody span or release has been publicly established, so none is entered.

operations.source: DOJ July2,2020 states age27. Circa1993 derived, possible1992 or1993; no exact birthday asserted. https://www.justice.gov/usao-ndil/pr/three-individuals-charged-trying-steal-cash-aurora-atm
